billing_flow_summary: Credits are deducted through RPC (deduct_credits_atomic), then business flow must mark completion or refund. Parallel non-atomic in-memory billing exists for signal consumption telemetry.

unsafe_billing_flows.risk: Two-phase charging without hard transactional outbox
unsafe_billing_flows.impact: Reserved transactions can remain stuck when downstream handler crashes/timeouts.
Revenue metrics drift and potential invoice mismatch after restarts.

unsafe_billing_flows.risk: Idempotency key usage not globally enforced
evidence: deduct_credits_atomic request_id accepted but uniqueness not enforced in shown schema

recommended_integrity_controls: Unique constraint on (user_id, request_id) where request_id is not null.
Hard timeout sweeper to auto-resolve 'reserved' status with deterministic policy.
Separate durable ledger table from operational transaction state.
